```{r setup,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readODS)

```


```{r}
drd_WIMD <- read_ods(
  "../data/raw/welsh-index-of-multiple-deprivation-wimd-2025-data-underlying-deep-dooted-deprivation-analysis.ods",
  sheet = "Data",
  skip = 4)%>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(.[[3]]))
cat("Loaded:", nrow(drd_WIMD), "rows |", ncol(drd_WIMD), "columns\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(names(drd_WIMD))
```

```{r}
drd_WIMD%>% count(category_of_deep_rooted_deprivation, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
drd_WIMD %>%
  filter(category_of_deep_rooted_deprivation != "LSOAs never ranked in top 50 most deprived") %>%
  count(local_authority, category_of_deep_rooted_deprivation) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = category_of_deep_rooted_deprivation,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

```

```{r}
ranks_cols<- names(drd_WIMD)[5:10]
drd_WIMD <- drd_WIMD%>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ranks_cols),~as.numeric(str_remove_all(as.character(.x),"[^0-9]"))
))
```

```{r}
cat("Suppressed/missing values per rank column:\n")
colSums(is.na(drd_WIMD[ranks_cols]))
```

```{r}
rank_cols <- c("wimd_2019_rank", "wimd_2014_rank", "wimd_2011_rank",
               "wimd_2008_rank", "wimd_2005_rank")


    
```

```{r}
for (col in rank_cols) {
  cat("\n===", col, "- suppressed LSOAs ===\n")
  missing_rows <- drd_WIMD[drd_WIMD[[col]] == "[x]", ]
  cat("Count:", nrow(missing_rows), "\n")
  print(missing_rows$lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa)
}
```

```{r}
suppressed_2019 <- drd_WIMD$lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa[drd_WIMD$wimd_2019_rank == "[x]"]
suppressed_2011 <- drd_WIMD$lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa[drd_WIMD$wimd_2011_rank == "[x]"]
suppressed_2005 <- drd_WIMD$lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa[drd_WIMD$wimd_2005_rank == "[x]"]
cat("2019 suppressed all in 2011 suppressed?", all(suppressed_2019 %in% suppressed_2011), "\n")

cat("\nIn 2011 but not 2019 (boundary additions):\n")
print(setdiff(suppressed_2011, suppressed_2019))
```


```{r}
drd_WIMD <- drd_WIMD %>%
  mutate(change_2019_to_2025 = wimd_2025_rank - wimd_2019_rank)

cat("Median change:", median(drd_WIMD$change_2019_to_2025, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Range:", range(drd_WIMD$change_2019_to_2025, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

```

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(drd_WIMD, aes(x = change_2019_to_2025)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title    = "Rank Change: WIMD 2019 to WIMD 2025",
    subtitle = "Context only — not interpreted as deprivation trend (WG methodology warning applies)",
    x        = "Change in overall rank (positive = higher rank number = less deprived in 2025)",
    y        = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
rank_cols <- c("wimd_2025_rank", "wimd_2019_rank", "wimd_2014_rank",
               "wimd_2011_rank", "wimd_2008_rank", "wimd_2005_rank")

drd_WIMD <- drd_WIMD %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(rank_sd = sd(c_across(all_of(rank_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Volatility summary (SD of WIMD ranks across all available iterations):\n")
summary(drd_WIMD$rank_sd)

```

```{r}
drd_WIMD %>%
  arrange(desc(rank_sd)) %>%
  select(local_authority, lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa, rank_sd) %>%
  head(10)

```
```{r}
drd_WIMD %>%
  arrange(rank_sd) %>%
  select(local_authority, lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa, rank_sd) %>%
  head(10)

```

```{r}
drd_WIMD %>%
  arrange(rank_sd) %>%
  select(local_authority, lower_layer_super_output_area_lsoa,
         category_of_deep_rooted_deprivation, rank_sd) %>%
  head(10)

```
